description: Use when sending emails, in-app bell notifications, SMS, or Slack messages from Salesforce Flow. Trigger keywords: 'send email action', 'custom notification', 'bell icon', 'Send Custom Notification', 'SMS from flow', 'Slack notification flow'. NOT for designing or managing email templates from Setup (use admin/email-templates-and-alerts), and NOT for Email Alerts defined in workflow rules.
inputs: Notification channel required: email, in-app bell, SMS, or Slack
Recipient type: User ID, email address string, or contact email
Org add-ons available: Digital Engagement, Salesforce for Slack
Email content source: plain text body or Text Template resource
name: flow-email-and-notifications
official_sources: Metadata API: FlowActionCall action types (`emailAlert`, `emailSimple`, `customNotificationAction`, `slackPostMessage`) at api_meta 264 L71245, L71272-71275, L71465; CustomNotificationType at api_meta 264 L43931-43967 and object_reference 264 L88451-88500; notification-action limit pkg2_dev 264 L5916; daily email limits apexdev 264 L20162-20177.
Salesforce Help — Flow Core Action: Send Custom Notification (Help-only, UNVERIFIED 2026-10-20) — https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=sf.flow_ref_elements_actions_sendcustomnotif.htm&type=5
Salesforce Help — Flow Core Action: Send Email — https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=sf.flow_ref_elements_actions_sendemail.htm&type=5

Salesforce Help — Considerations for Processes that Send Custom Notifications (10,000 notification actions/hour per org is also in pkg2_dev 264 L5916; "unsent notifications are lost, not faulted" and "10,000 recipients per notification" are Help-only, UNVERIFIED 2026-10-20) — https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=platform.process_limits_customnotification.htm&type=5

Apex Reference Guide — Messaging.CustomNotification: title max 250, body max 750 (apexref 262 L166708, L166711), recipients active users only, up to 500 IDs (L166770-166781). Custom Notification invocable action page — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_action.meta/api_action/actions_obj_custom_notification.htm

Recipient wiring plan (User ID vs email address)
